verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents its own SIP telephony stack. It covers inbound and outbound calls and uses outbound trunks for placing calls, so SIP trunking is a first-party capability. However, the evidence never explicitly says you can bring your own carrier or PBX, or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers, instead of using bundled telephony. Missing for 10: explicit bring-your-own-carrier/PBX trunk configuration docs, inbound trunk documentation, Twilio/Telnyx number import, independent hands-on corroboration of third-party trunk connectivity.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: Outbound trunks are used to place outgoing calls.
LiveKit telephony lets you build AI-powered voice apps that handle inbound and outbound calls.
Works seamlessly with LiveKit's telephony stack, allowing your agent to make calls to or receive calls from phones.
